paraphrase: The V1 package: analytic sentences are true at every world; a sentence is meaningful iff it is analytic or conclusively verifiable; and the language has a universal law over infinitely many individuals with an observable possible counterinstance. Unattributed as a package: the criterion is Ayer's strong sense (AYER-LTL-PELICAN-I-18-STRONG-WEAK), which he reports some positivists proposed (AYER-LTL-PELICAN-I-18-CONCLUSIVE-PROPOSED).
